mission_objective_own_words: We are building the governed substrate where verified work compounds and nothing silently disappears; this merge lands the design-block library on main cleanly under the Scorecard Law.

relevant_domains.why_this_task: The assignment is a merge, and Domain 8 owns merge mechanics: verify the tree mechanically before moving the ref, because tree=head-tree silently drops base changes, and re-check the tip at action instant because a decision expires when the tip moves.

Merging under the Scorecard Law means no ref moves without a 9.0+ independent scorecard receipt and green CI on the exact tip. That is Domain 5.4; merging without the protocol is the violation, not the merge itself.

The tip re-check is Domain 1.8 in action: the merge decision was computed on one tip, and if the tip moved before the ref update, the decision is dead and must be re-validated on the new bytes before acting.
